display.purpose: Page hero only. One per page, weight 900.

label.purpose: Blue uppercase section category, 0.22em tracked. Names a category; never a section separator.

shadows.name: control-float
shadows.purpose: Carousel arrows and other floating round controls.

motion.name: copy-arrive

components.name: Primary Button

components.name: Secondary Button (light ground)
components.description: The alternate path next to a primary action, on canvas or surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary-light { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Host Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.82rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: #1A1410; text-decoration: none; padding: 0.88rem 2.2rem; border: 1.5px solid rgba(15,11,9,0.22); border-radius: 50px; background: linear-gradient(to right, #0F0B09 50%, transparent 50%); background-size: 200% 100%; background-position: 100% 0; transition: background-position 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 0.3s; } .ds-btn-secondary-light:hover { background-position: 0 0; color: #fff; border-color: #0F0B09; }

components.name: Section Eyebrow
components.description: Names a section's category. One per section at most, and not on every section.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { display: block; font-family: 'Host Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #007AC2; margin-bottom: 1rem; }

components.name: Media Card
components.description: An inset photograph. Rounds at 20px because it is inset; a full-bleed image would be square and unshadowed.
components.css: .ds-card-media { position: relative; margin: 0; aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; border-radius: 20px; overflow: hidden; background: #F4F2EF; box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(15,11,9,0.14); transition: box-shadow 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-card-media img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 1s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-card-media:hover { box-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgba(15,11,9,0.2); } .ds-card-media:hover img { transform: scale(1.03); }

narrative.overview:
Jayco makes equipment for people who go outside. The design language is the same: plain-spoken, sturdy, built for use. Photography does the selling — real coaches in real places, at real scale — and everything else gets out of its way. Type is one family at honest weights. Blue is a signal, not a mood: it marks the way forward and nothing else. Space is generous because the products are large and the decisions are expensive.

The tone is confident without hype. Copy names the thing — "20 feet 11 inches", "276 hp", "fits a standard parking space" — because specificity is what persuades a buyer spending six figures. Adjectives are what a competitor writes when they have nothing to measure.

The anti-reference is the RV-industry default: stock lifestyle photography behind a gradient scrim, gold-and-burgundy luxury cues, exclamation marks, and specs dumped as a wall of unexplained numbers.
keyCharacteristics: One typeface, Host Grotesk, weight-led from 900 display to 400 body
One accent, Jayco Blue #007AC2, rationed to actions, active state and eyebrows
Three grounds: cool canvas, warm surface, warm ink
Radius follows bleed: inset media rounds at 20px, full-bleed media is square
Tonal depth first; shadow only where something genuinely lifts
One authored motion moment per page, everything else a quiet shared handoff
Hairlines instead of containers wherever a card would be too much

rules.name: Radius Follows Bleed
rules.body: Media inset inside the gutters rounds at 20px whatever its scale. Media that runs edge-to-edge is square, with no radius and no shadow. The only permitted animated radius is the transition between those two states, and it always settles on a correct static value.

rules.name: One Authored Moment
rules.body: A page gets exactly one orchestrated motion sequence. Everything else uses the shared handoff: text arrives once at 0.5s power2.out and never reverses; photography drifts linearly and never fades. Eleven distinct transitions read as less crafted, not more.

rules.name: Ration The Blue
rules.body: Jayco Blue marks the way forward: primary actions, active navigation, section eyebrows, and one hero figure. It never becomes a background wash, a gradient, or a mood. More than one blue emphasis per screen means one of them is decoration.

rules.name: Name The Number, Then Explain It
rules.body: A specification without a narrative line is data, not persuasion. Pair every figure with the sentence that says what it means for the owner.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Is A System
rules.body: The blue uppercase label names a section's category. It is not a separator, and it does not appear over every block simply because a block exists.

dos: Do let one photograph carry a section: full-bleed, square, drifting slowly
Do ration the blue to one emphasis per screen
Do name the number, then explain what it means
Do give a heading more space above than below it
Do keep inset media at 20px and full-bleed media square
Do give a page one authored motion moment and one quiet handoff for everything else
Do keep controls quiet, consistent, and in the pill vocabulary
donts: Don't round a full-bleed image, and don't shadow one
Don't put a tracked uppercase eyebrow over every section
Don't build a page out of same-size icon-heading-text cards, and never nest a card inside a card
Don't set gradient text, or use glass and blur as decoration rather than as a specific effect
Don't use a colored border-left above 1px on cards, list items or callouts
Don't animate every section's entrance identically, or reinterpret a scrolled page as a staggered list
Don't substitute stock photography for a Jayco product
Don't state a claim the product cannot prove
